{{Quote|Gratitude is foreign to me, and yet this day you have done me a great service. Me, and those who come after me. Your ship awaits in the hall beyond. You may take it and go.|[[Wutzek]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
The '''skirmish in the Hellhoop''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mistakenly states that this event took place some years after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. It also mistakenly states that [[Wutzek]] (misspelled ''Wuzzek''), killed all of the [[Five]] but [[Chokla]] and then destroyed the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. Wutzek actually killed all members of the Five and then only destroyed their [[Five's warship|warship]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|32|Hellhoop}}</ref>
